story.i_want: to complete my profile after registration
story.so_that: the app can personalize my experience and enable proper user identification

criterion.title: Profile Form Fields
criterion.details: User can enter full name (required), phone number (optional), select timezone from dropdown (required). All fields validate before saving.

criterion.title: Profile Picture Upload
criterion.details: User can upload profile picture (optional). Image preview shown before saving. Supported formats: JPG, PNG (max 5MB). Default avatar used if not uploaded.

criterion.title: Notification Preferences
criterion.details: User can enable/disable push notifications, email notifications, and set reminder frequency (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly). Settings saved with profile.

criterion.title: Skip Option
criterion.details: "Skip for now" button available. User can access profile setup later from settings. App continues to main screen if skipped.

criterion.title: Save & Validation
criterion.details: Profile saved successfully to Supabase profiles table. Success message shown. User redirected to onboarding tutorial (US-1.4) or main screen. Profile save completes in <2 seconds.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Acceptance criteria for profile setup including form fields, image upload, notification preferences, skip option, and save validation. Profile must save in under 2 seconds to Supabase profiles table.

doc.title: Design System Documentation
doc.section: Shadow System, Color Palette, Typography, Spacing
doc.snippet: Two-layer shadow system (ambient + directional), color palette with 10 shades per color (primary blue, secondary purple, neutral gray), responsive box-based layouts. Use theme.colors, theme.shadows, theme.spacing for all styling.

doc.title: Database Schema
doc.snippet: CREATE TABLE profiles (user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users PRIMARY KEY, full_name TEXT, phone TEXT, timezone TEXT, avatar_url TEXT, notification_preferences JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP). RLS policies: users can only read/update their own profile.

doc.title: Data Transfer Objects
doc.snippet: Profile interface with userId, fullName, phone, timezone, avatarUrl, notificationPreferences (object with email, push, reminderFrequency fields).

doc.title: Component Interfaces
doc.snippet: Atomic component interfaces for Input (with validation, error states) and Button (with variants, sizes, loading states). UserSettings includes notification preferences structure.

doc.title: Theme System Usage Guide
doc.section: Quick Start, Color Usage, Shadow Usage
doc.snippet: Import theme and use ThemeProvider. Access colors via theme.colors.primary[500], shadows via theme.shadows.md, spacing via theme.spacing[4]. Use responsive hooks: useResponsive(), useGridColumns().

constraint.rule: Follow Atomic Design pattern: Screen component uses atoms (Input, Button) from mobile/src/components/atoms/
Use Redux Toolkit for global profile state. Create profileSlice.ts with async thunks for Supabase operations. Follow authSlice.ts patterns.
ALL styling must use theme system: theme.colors for colors, theme.shadows for elevation, theme.spacing for padding/margin, theme.typography for text styles. NO hardcoded values.
Implement responsive design using breakpoints (phone: 0-599px, tablet: 600-1023px, desktop: 1024px+). Use useResponsive() hook. Rearrange layout, don't just shrink.
Update profiles table via Supabase client. Table has RLS policies - users can only update their own profile. Use user_id from auth.users as foreign key.
Upload profile pictures to Supabase Storage bucket 'avatars' with path: public/{user_id}/avatar.jpg. Public read access, user-only write access.
Validate all fields before saving: full name (2-100 chars, spaces/hyphens/apostrophes only), phone (E.164 format if provided), timezone (valid IANA), image (JPG/PNG, max 5MB).

Add ProfileSetupScreen to auth navigation stack. Navigate from SignupScreen after successful registration. On "Save", navigate to OnboardingTutorial (US-1.4) or Main. On "Skip", navigate directly to Main.
Profile save must complete in under 2 seconds. Use loading states during async operations. Handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages.
All interactive elements must have accessibility labels, roles, and states. Support screen readers. Ensure WCAG AA compliance. Use semantic HTML/RN components.

standards.paragraph: Use Jest for unit/integration tests, React Native Testing Library for component tests. Test files located in mobile/__tests__/ directory. Follow test pyramid: 60% unit, 30% integration, 10% E2E. Use AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert). One assertion per test with descriptive names. Mock Supabase client for tests.

ideas.idea: Test full name validation: accepts valid names with spaces/hyphens/apostrophes, rejects special characters, enforces 2-100 character length
Test phone validation: accepts E.164 format, allows empty/null (optional field), rejects invalid formats
Test timezone validation: accepts valid IANA timezones, rejects invalid values, requires selection
Test image upload: accepts JPG/PNG under 5MB, rejects oversized files, rejects unsupported formats, handles upload errors
Test image preview: displays selected image before save, shows default avatar if no image selected
Test notification preferences: toggles work correctly, reminder frequency selector works, preferences saved with profile
Test skip functionality: "Skip" button navigates to next screen, profile can be accessed later from settings
Test profile save: successful save updates Redux store, updates Supabase profiles table, shows success message, navigates to next screen
Test error handling: network errors show user-friendly message, validation errors prevent save, storage errors handled gracefully
Test accessibility: all inputs have labels, buttons have accessibility roles, screen reader navigation works
